phaseName: Core Apps I: Notes, Calculator, Terminal
goal: Implement three smaller core apps with full behavior and tests: Notes (CRUD persisted), Calculator (arithmetic + keyboard), Terminal (command parser over the shared mock FS).
summary: Phase 4 complete: Notes, Calculator, Terminal apps fully built with unit + UI interaction tests. Step 1 (Notes): useNotes hook with localStorage CRUD — createNote/updateNote/deleteNote all route through `update()` wrapper that persists. deleteNote shifts activeId via useEffect (pure updater, no setState inside updater). Notes UI with sidebar (search, list, new-note) + editor. 6 persistence tests + 8 hook CRUD tests (renderHook, incl. deleteNote-persists-to-localStorage test verifying deleted note absent from localStorage). Step 2 (Calculator): engine.ts safe shunting-yard parser (operator precedence, parentheses, decimals, division-by-zero→NaN), Calculator UI with button grid + full keyboard. 19 engine tests. Step 3 (Terminal): parser.ts with 8 commands over shared mockFS (ls/cd/cat/echo/pwd/mkdir/clear/help + whoami/date, echo > redirect), Terminal UI with history + Ctrl+L clear (fixed clear bug). 24 parser tests. Added 15 E2E UI interaction tests: Notes create/edit/delete/reload-persistence/search, Calculator button+keyboard+Escape+Backspace+precedence, Terminal ls/pwd/cd/history/clear/cat/echo-redirect. Verification: `npx vitest run` → 100 passed; `npx playwright test` → 59 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (59 modules).
